scientific_integrity: The all-rank conclusion follows by a squarefree central-coefficient ideal induction. Finite exact computations are separate supporting tests, not an infinite proof. The assessment is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns vector subspaces generated by left-normed Jordan products in characteristic two for finite direct products of D8/Q8 and a finite abelian group. It does not claim a classification of arbitrary group rings or two-sided lower Lie ideals. Published and unindexed priority may require further specialist review.
title: Exact lower Jordan-power dimensions in modular products of dihedral and quaternion groups
